entries.title: Proverbs 3:1
segments: ¶My son, do not forget my law, But let your heart keep my commands;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:2
segments: For length of days and long life And peace they will add to you.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:3
segments: Let not mercy and truth forsake you; Bind them around your neck, Write them on the tablet of your heart,

entries.title: Proverbs 3:4
segments: [And] so find favor and high esteem In the sight of God and man.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:5
segments: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, And lean not on your own understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:6
segments: In all your ways acknowledge Him, And He shall direct your paths.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:7
segments: ¶Do not be wise in your own eyes; Fear the LORD and depart from evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:8
segments: It will be health to your flesh, And strength to your bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:9
segments: Honor the LORD with your possessions, And with the firstfruits of all your increase;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:10
segments: So your barns will be filled with plenty, And your vats will overflow with new wine.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:11
segments: My son, do not despise the chastening of the LORD, Nor detest His correction;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:12
segments: For whom the LORD loves He corrects, Just as a father the son [in whom] he delights.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:13
segments: ¶Happy [is] the man [who] finds wisdom, And the man [who] gains understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:14
segments: For her proceeds [are] better than the profits of silver, And her gain than fine gold.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:15
segments: She [is] more precious than rubies, And all the things you may desire cannot compare with her.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:16
segments: Length of days [is] in her right hand, In her left hand riches and honor.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:17
segments: Her ways [are] ways of pleasantness, And all her paths [are] peace.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:18
segments: She [is] a tree of life to those who take hold of her, And happy [are all] who retain her.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:19
segments: The LORD by wisdom founded the earth; By understanding He established the heavens;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:20
segments: By His knowledge the depths were broken up, And clouds drop down the dew.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:21
segments: ¶My son, let them not depart from your eyes-Keep sound wisdom and discretion;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:22
segments: So they will be life to your soul And grace to your neck.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:23
segments: Then you will walk safely in your way, And your foot will not stumble.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:24
segments: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; Yes, you will lie down and your sleep will be sweet.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:25
segments: Do not be afraid of sudden terror, Nor of trouble from the wicked when it comes;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:26
segments: For the LORD will be your confidence, And will keep your foot from being caught.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:27
segments: ¶Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, When it is in the power of your hand to do [so].

entries.title: Proverbs 3:28
segments: Do not say to your neighbor, "Go, and come back, And tomorrow I will give [it]," When [you have] it with you.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:29
segments: Do not devise evil against your neighbor, For he dwells by you for safety's sake.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:30
segments: Do not strive with a man without cause, If he has done you no harm.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:31
segments: Do not envy the oppressor, And choose none of his ways;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:32
segments: For the perverse [person is] an abomination to the LORD, But His secret counsel [is] with the upright.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:33
segments: The curse of the LORD [is] on the house of the wicked, But He blesses the home of the just.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:34
segments: Surely He scorns the scornful, But gives grace to the humble.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:35
segments: The wise shall inherit glory, But shame shall be the legacy of fools.
